source: The woman in the black nun’s attire felt Lumian’s gaze, turning her head slightly and locking eyes with him.
target: Femina in veste nigra monialis Lumiani aspectum sensit, caput parum vertens atque oculos cum eo iungens.

source: Lumian’s gaze met hers, filled with indescribable colors, and the figure in his line of sight vanished.
target: Aspectus Lumiani cum eius convenit, coloribus ineffabilibus saturatus, atque figura in eius conspectu evanuit.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian recognized the insignificance of this occurrence.
target: Simul, Lumian insignificantiam huius eventus agnovit.

source: It didn’t warrant further consideration.
target: Non meruit ulteriorem considerationem.

source: Beside the incumbent Governor of the Sea, Juan Oro noticed the once calm azure sea undulating.
target: Iuxta gubernatorem maris praesens, Juan Oro, animadvertit mare, quod olim placidum caeruleum erat, nunc undulantem.

source: In the gray sky, stars barely visible to the naked eye underwent changes, stirring an inexplicable throbbing and emotional shift within him.
target: In caelo griseo, stellae, vix oculis nudis perceptae, mutationes passi sunt, excitantes in eo inexplicabilem palpitationem atque motum animi.

source: An anomaly?
target: Anomalia?

source: Juan Oro couldn’t determine if it was good or bad.
target: Juan Oro determinare non potuit utrum id bonum an malum esset.

source: Given the circumstances, any change was treated as an accident, potentially caused by a hidden enemy.
target: Ex circumstantiis, omnis mutatio quasi casus habebatur, fortasse ab hoste occulto orta.

source: Without hesitation, he forcefully thrust the Ring of the Sea Queen into the hands of the incoming Governor of the Sea, Simon, growling, “Hurry up and marry the sea!”
target: Sine mora, vi compulsa, anulum reginae maris in manus gubernatoris maris adventientis, Simone, rugiens, impellit: “Festina et mare coniunge!”

source: In a moment of desperation, the president of the Fisheries Guild unintentionally failed to alter his voice to sound like Jorge.
target: In momento desperationis, praeses Collegii Piscandi, casu, non potuit vocem suam mutare ut similis esset Jorge.

source: However, his vocal cords had changed, making him sound younger than usual.
target: Attamen, chordae vocales eius mutatae erant, facientes eum iuvenius quam solet sonare.

source: Simon, taken aback by the shout, didn’t notice Juan Oro’s voice shift.
target: Simon, clamore obstupefactus, mutationem vocis Juan Oro non animadvertit.

source: He raised his hand, clutching the Ring of the Sea Queen, and recited, “I espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion!”
target: Manum levavit, anulum reginae maris prehendens, atque recitavit: “Te coniugo, o mare, ut signum verae et perpetuae dominationis!”

source: With that, he threw the unique golden ring.
target: Hoc facto, anulum aureum unicum iecit.

source: It trembled with light, its surface covered in a gentle glow.
target: Illud luce tremens erat, et eius superficies lumine levi induta erat.

source: As the Ring of the Sea Queen submerged, its glow intensified and expanded to the size of a baby before transforming into a cone of light, vanishing into the azure seawater.
target: Cum anulus reginae maris submersus est, fulgor eius intensior factus est atque ad magnitudinem infanti expansus, antequam in conum lucis transformaretur, in aquam caeruleam evanuit.

source: In the next moment, Juan Oro, Lumian, and the rest heard a deafening boom.
target: In momento sequenti, Juan Oro, Lumian, et ceteri strepitum tonitruosum audiverunt.

source: Splash!
target: Splash!

source: The sea boiled, unleashing huge waves that catapulted the colorful flower boat into the air.
target: Mare ebullivit, immensas undas efferens, quae naviculam floribus variis ornatam in aethera proiecerunt.

source: A destructive aura echoed in the surroundings.
target: Aura destructiva in ambitu resonabat.

source: Wh… The sea’s fury!
target: Heu... furor maris!

source: How could this happen?
target: Quomodo hoc evenire potuit?

source: Juan Oro’s pupils dilated in disbelief.
target: Pupillae Juan Oro incredulitate dilatatae sunt.

source: He couldn’t fathom that they had angered the sea again.
target: Non potuit concipere quod iterum mare iratum haberent.

source: It seemed like this year’s sea prayer ritual had failed once more.
target: Videbatur ritu orationis maris huius anni iterum defuisse.

source: He had meticulously followed every step, witnessing the placement of the Ring of the Sea Queen on the dilapidated stone platform representing the ancestors.
target: Omnem viam diligenter secutus est, et testatus est anulum Reginæ Maris super lapsum podium lapideum, quod maiores repraesentabat, positum esse.

source: He personally retrieved and guarded it with utmost vigilance.
target: Ipse anulum recuperavit et summa diligentia custodivit.

source: Everything went smoothly!
target: Omnia sine impedimento processerunt!

source: How could this be?
target: Quomodo hoc fieri potuit?

source: As the bridal boat teetered on the verge of capsizing, Juan Oro clenched his fists, and crystalline scales resembling starlight manifested on his body.
target: Dum navicula nuptialis ad naufragium labebatur, Juan Oro manus constringit, et squamae crystallinae, quae luce stellarum similes erant, in corpore eius apparuerunt.

source: His eyes darkened, resembling resplendent stars emerging within.
target: Oculi eius obscurati sunt, instar stellarum splendidarum intus emergentium.

source: He melded with the “sea.”
target: Se cum mari coniunxit.

source: The crashing sound abruptly ceased, and the majestic, terrifying azure waves froze in midair, as if held tightly by an unseen hand.
target: Strepitus ruentis repente cessavit, et undae caeruleae, majestosae ac terribiles, in aere immobilatae sunt, quasi manu invisibili retentae.

source: In Milo Village, within the cathedral-like Governor of the Sea’s building.
target: In vico Milo, intra aedificium gubernatoris maris, quod simile cathedrali apparuit.

source: The imposter Governor of the Sea, Miguel, lay in the servant’s room.
target: Falsus gubernator maris, Miguel, in conclavi ministrorum iacebat.

source: Suddenly, he sat up and leisurely rose from the bed, a self-satisfied smile playing on his face.
target: Subito, se excitavit et ex lecto lente surrexit, cum in facie risu sibi ipsi satisfacto ludenti.

source: Standing before a glass window overlooking the weeds outside, he muttered to himself, It’s almost time…
target: Stans ante fenestram vitream, ex qua herbae foris conspicuae erant, submurmuravit: “Fere tempus est…”

source: I wonder how Juan Oro will react when he discovers the sea sacrifice has failed again. Heh heh, this is payback for all the ‘care’ he’s given me over the past year.
target: Miror quomodo Juan Oro reagat, cum inveniet sacrifaciem maris iterum defuisse. Heh heh, hoc est ultio pro omni cura, quam mihi per annum praeteritum dedit.

source: What’s Loki up to?
target: Quid Loki agit?

source: Why the sudden deviation from the original plan?
target: Cur subito a consilio originali discedit?

source: Isn’t he concerned about potential accidents?
target: Numquid non sollicitus est de eventibus fortuitis?

source: Miguel—a key member of April Fool’s, Bard—had previously disguised himself as the sailor, Iru, and boarded the ship, escaping with Mad Lady when he jumped into the sea.
target: Miguel—membrum clavis Aprilis Follis, Bard—olim se sub specie nautae, Iru, celavit et navigium conscendit, cum Mad Lady effugeret, in mare insiliens.

source: Their plan over the course of the past year was devised last year.
target: Consilium eorum, quod totum annum praeteritum complebat, anno ultimo excogitatum est.

source: They had selected locals from Port Santa who resembled the unfortunate governor.
target: Loci ex Portu Santa electi erant, qui infelici gubernatorem simulabant.

source: After disrupting the sea sacrifice and returning ashore, they promptly killed one of their targets, allowing Bard to assume the guise.
target: Postquam sacrifacium maris perturbaverunt et in terram redierunt, unum ex propositis suis celeriter occiderunt, quo Bard personam assumere potuit.

source: Their confidence in Miguel—disguised by Bard—becoming the false Governor of the Sea stemmed from Ultraman taking charge of the matter.
target: Fides eorum in Miguel, a Bard simulato, falsum gubernatorem maris fieri, ex Ultraman rem regendi suscipienda orta erat.

source: To prevent potential rebellion from peripheral April Fool’s members, Bard, a former Swindler, intentionally wrote Emperor Roselle’s Secret Chronicles and handed them to Loki.
target: Ut rebellionem potentialem a membris Aprilis Follis marginariis prohiberet, Bard, olim fraudator, conscie “Chronicas Secretas” Imperatoris Roselle scripsit et eas Loki tradidit.

source: The latter discreetly distributed them in Trier, creating the illusion of Bard’s activity in Intis.
target: Ille eas in Treviris caute disseminavit, creando illusionem activitatis Bardianae in Intis.

source: This tactic prevented others from connecting Miguel—obediently residing in the Governor of the Sea’s residence—to Bard.
target: Haec tactica impediit alios cum Miguel, qui in residentia gubernatoris maris oboedienter habitabat, coniungi cum Bard.

source: Writing about Emperor Roselle’s romantic past indeed amused Bard, and witnessing Juan Oro’s reactions, including the lashing with a crutch before intimate encounters with his granddaughter and the wives and daughters of relevant personnel, greatly satisfied Bard’s mischievous tendencies.
target: Scrībere de praeterito amoroso Imperatoris Roselle vere Bard delectabat, et videndo reactiones Juan Oro, inter quas etiam flagellatio baculo ante congressūs intimos cum nepōta et uxoribus ac filiis pertinentibus, Bardis ingenia malitiosa maxime satisfaciebat.

source: However, pranks were secondary.
target: Attamen ioci erant secundarii.

source: Bard’s main objective in assuming the disguise of the Governor of the Sea was clear:
target: Praecipuum propositum Bard in assumenda specie gubernatoris maris clarum erat:

source: He gained unrestricted access to the basement of the building, believed by Milo Village’s inhabitants to be the sacrificial ground for their ancestors!
target: Ille accessum ad subsolum aedificii, quod incolae vici Milo putabant esse locum sacrificii maiorum suorum, sine limitatione adeptus est!

source: Despite being a fake Governor of the Sea under the watchful eyes of sea spawn in the house, he had free rein everywhere except the ring-making ritual grounds and the vigil room.
target: Quamquam falsus gubernator maris, sub oculis vigilantibus progeniei maris in domo, ubique sine restrictione agebat, excepto in agris ritus anuli faciendi et in cella vigili.

source: Only those two areas were off-limits unless he crossed a line.
target: Illae duo sola loca erant clausae, nisi fines transgressisset.

source: Moreover, Ultraman confirmed that the basement of the Governor’s residence held no value for the sea spawn.
target: Praeterea, Ultraman confirmavit subsolum residentiae gubernatoris maris nullam utilitatem pro progenie maris habere.

source: Except for two symbolic guards at the staircase, there were no monitors or protectors inside.
target: Nisi duos custodes symbolicos ad scalas, nulli intus vigiles nec protectores erant.

source: Villagers of Milo Village only visited occasionally, showing respect for the Governor of the Sea by not entering or leaving the building without permission.
target: Incolae vici Milo tantum interdum visitabant, gubernatori maris reverentiam tribuentes, neque aedificium sine licentia intrantes nec exiens.

source: This provided ample opportunities for Bard, the imposter Governor of the Sea.
target: Hoc Bard, impostor gubernator maris, multa opportunitates adeptus est.

source: Thinking about the expressions of Juan Oro and Lumian Lee when they witnessed the sea prayer ritual’s failure again, Bard couldn’t help but chuckle.
target: Cogitans de vultibus Juan Oro et Lumian Lee, cum iterum ritu orationis maris defecerunt, Bard non potuit se ab iocoso risu abstinere.

source: He muttered in a mocking tone, You know the sea sacrifice, ring-making, and vigil happen once a year. Haven’t you considered that the ancestral sacrificial ritual can only occur annually?
target: Submurmuravit in tono derisorio, “Scitis sacrificialem maris, ritum anuli conficiendi atque vigiliam semel in anno evenire. Numne existimastis ritualem sacrificii maiorum solum annuo fieri posse?”

source: That dilapidated altar requires the slow accumulation of worshippers’ spirituality. It takes almost twelve months to gather the necessary enchantment.
target: Illud lapsum aram requirit tardam accumulationem spiritualis cultus. Fere duodecim menses opus est ad incantationem necessariam congregandam.

source: Over half a month before the basement gained serious attention, he had strategically placed an item related to one of the three pathways on the altar, openly siphoning the accumulated theft powers!
target: Dimidiā mense antequam subsolum graviter attentum fuisset, rem ad unam ex tribus viis pertinentem in aram strategice posuerat, vim furtivae potentiae accumulationis aperte exhauriens!

source: With this plan, Bard believed that, regardless of the success of the previous night’s ring-making ritual, regardless of how closely Juan Oro and Lumian Lee guarded against the replacement of the Ring of the Sea Queen, it wouldn’t possess the ability to steal power from the sea bottom.
target: Hoc consilio, Bard credebat, quod, sive successerit ritu conficiendi anuli nocturni praeteriti, sive quantum Juan Oro et Lumian Lee contra substitutionem Anuli Reginæ Maris diligenter vigilarent, ille non esset idoneus potentiam e fundo maris furandi.

source: Hence, the sea prayer ritual was destined to fail. The seal would further open, and the long-accumulated “volcano” inside would erupt!
target: Itaque, ritu orationis maris deficiendum esse destinatum erat. Sigillum ulterius aperietur, et vulcanus interne, diu accumulatus, erupturus erit!

source: Anyone attempting to stop it would perish!
target: Quicumque id prohibere conaretur, periret!

source: Last year, the reason April Fool’s took the risk of making Mad Lady a deputy host and deliberately replacing the Ring of the Sea Queen on the sacrificial ancestor’s stone platform with another item arose because the theory that the high-level stealing power could only be used once a year wasn’t entirely confirmed.
target: Anno ultimo, ratio cur Aprilis Follis periculum susceperat ut Mad Lady hospitis vicaria fieret atque conscie Anulum Reginæ Maris in podium lapideum maiorum sacrificiorum alio substitueretur, orta est ex theoria, quae affirmare non potuit potentiam altissimam furandi solum semel in anno adhiberi posse.

source: Although Ultraman could analyze and experiment in the basement, he refrained from doing so too frequently to avoid suspicion.
target: Quamquam Ultraman in subsolum analyzare et experimenta gerere poterat, nimis saepe id facere vitavit, ne suspectio oriretur.

source: Following the sea prayer ritual failure last year and the subsequent monthly experiments over the past eleven months, Bard, Ultraman, and Mad Lady were now certain that they didn’t need to go through the trouble of replacing the real Ring of the Sea Queen.
target: Post defectum ritu orationis maris anno ultimo atque experimenta mensia per undecim menses subsequentes, Bard, Ultraman, et Mad Lady iam certi erant se non necesse habere verum Anulum Reginæ Maris reponere.

source: Instead, they could preemptively take away the theft power. Thus, they sneered at Lumian Lee’s efforts, unconcerned about his actions or the need for destructive measures to avoid detection by the Earth Mother Church.
target: Potius vim furtivae praeemptive auferre poterant. Itaque de conatibus Lumian Lee irriserunt, nihil solliciti de actionibus eius aut de mensuris destructivis ad detectionem a Ecclesia Matris Terrae vitandam.

source: Despite their confidence, they still had to maintain appearances, including seeking help from Lumian Lee.
target: Non obstante fiducia, tamen speciem servare oportebat, inter quae auxilium a Lumian Lee petere incluebatur.

source: Bard shifted his gaze, averting it to his left hand.
target: Bard conspectum suum ad manum sinistram devolvit.

source: There were signs of a ring being worn there.
target: Apparuerunt signa quod anulus ibi indutus esset.

source: This was, in fact, the item carrying the key functions of the Ring of the Sea Queen!
target: Hoc, re vera, erat res quae functiones principales Anuli Reginæ Maris portabat!

source: Port Santa, Solow Motel, at the entrance of the fifth-floor suite.
target: Port Santa, Solow Motel, ad introitum conclavis tabulatae quintae.

source: “Hugging” Madame Giorgia, Lugano’s thoughts faltered, as if the iron gears were covered in yellow rust or lacking lubricant.
target: “Amplexans” Madame Giorgia, Lugano cogitationes titubaverunt, quasi rotae ferreae flavo rubore tectae vel lubricante carentes essent.

source: W-what’s… going on?
target: Q-quid… agitur?

source: Am I… under attack?
target: Num sub impetu sum?

source: No… I have to hurry… I have to… get rid… of this state…
target: Non… cito agere debeo… mihi oportet… hanc conditionem tollere…

source: Lugano attempted to push away the woman in his arms, only to realize she had become surprisingly heavy.
target: Lugano conatus est mulierem in brachiis suis repellere, sed animadvertit eam mirum modum grave factam esse.

source: Using her joints subtly, Madame Giorgia prevented him from raising his arms and legs. The movements resembled a lovers’ playful interaction.
target: Subtiliter articulos suos adhibens, Madame Giorgia eum prohibuit brachia et crura tollere. Motus similes erant ludicrae amantium interationi.

source: Coupled with his disjointed thoughts, even a Planter like Lugano couldn’t break free from Giorgia’s restraints.
target: Cum cogitationibus suis dissociatis, etiam cultor ut Lugano vinculis Madame Giorgiae liberari non potuit.

source: Panicking, Lugano opened his mouth, about to call for help.
target: Perturbatus, Lugano os aperuit, auxilium clamare paratus.

source: Just then, Giorgia lifted her head, pressing her red lips against his.
target: Tum, Giorgia caput levavit, labra sua rubra in eius os premens.

source: Lugano was momentarily taken aback.
target: Lugano momento obstupefactus est.

source: In the adjacent room, Jenna, disguised as a female mercenary, held a mirror to “reflect” the situation in Lumian’s living room through the glass and other items.
target: In cella contigua, Jenna, sub specie mercenariae feminae, speculum tenebat ad rem in conclavi Lumiani per vitrum aliaque media reflectendam.

source: Seeing Lugano and Giorgia embracing and flirting, Jenna couldn’t help but curse under her breath, “Dammit, can you even go into heat at a time like this? And in front of a child!”
target: Videns Lugano et Giorgia se amplectentes atque inter se jocantes, Jenna submurmuravit maledice, “Maledictum, num quidem in hoc tempore ardorem capitis excitare potestis? Atque coram puero!”

source: Considering that Franca would be joined by members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, Lumian tasked Jenna with secretly monitoring Lugano to figure out what was wrong with the interpreter.
target: Cum Franca a membris Societatis Inquisitionis Simiorum Crisporum coniungeretur, Lumian Jennam commissum habuit ut clam Lugano observaret, ut cognosceret quid interpres male essent.

source: As a former Showy Diva, Jenna had witnessed similar scenes and even more restrictive ones. She couldn’t fathom why they chose to display such affection at the door.
target: Cum olim Diva ostentatrix fuerit, Jenna similes scaenas atque etiam magis reclusas viderat. Non potuit intellegere cur talem affectionem ad ianuam exhibere maluerint.

source: At that moment, Anthony Reid, standing beside her, looked at the mirror and frowned.
target: Illo momento, Anthony Reid, iuxta eam stans, speculum aspexit et fronde contremuit.

source: “It doesn’t seem like they’re making out. Their actions and expressions aren’t typical of people engaged in such activities.”
target: “Non videtur eos amplexari. Acta eorum et vultus non sunt proprii hominibus talibus in rebus versantibus.”
